details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded approximately $996 million in net inflows last week, marking their strongest performance in over three months since early January. This surge in demand reflects improving investor sentiment towards Bitcoin despite ongoing geopolitical volatility.
title: US Bitcoin ETFs See Nearly $1 Billion Inflows, Strongest Since January

details: Bitcoin experienced significant price volatility on April 18, 2026, pulling back to the $75,800-$77,100 range after briefly surpassing $78,000. This movement followed reports that Iran's military reasserted control over the Strait of Hormuz, contradicting earlier claims of its reopening, leading to renewed geopolitical uncertainty.
title: Bitcoin Volatility Surges as Iran Closes Hormuz Strait After Brief Reopening

details: Ethereum's price is currently stalled around the $2,400 mark, struggling to overcome resistance levels. This occurs despite the network recording a historical high of 200.4 million base-layer transactions in Q1 2026, indicating a divergence between strong network usage and price performance, partly due to reduced transaction fees post-Dencun upgrade.
title: Ethereum Price Stalls Near $2,400 Despite Record Network Activity

details: The number of XRP wallets holding between 1,000 and 100,000 tokens has hit a new historical peak of 1.1 million. This increase in retail participation is noteworthy, especially as it occurred despite a 52% price decline for XRP since October 2025, with over 77,500 new retail wallets added during this period.
title: XRP Retail Wallets Reach Record 1.1 Million Despite Price Drop

details: U.S. Representative Sheri Biggs has publicly disclosed a personal investment ranging from $100,000 to $250,000 in BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) last month. This development highlights a growing trend of elected officials and mainstream policymakers directly engaging with the cryptocurrency market through regulated investment products.
title: US Congresswoman Sheri Biggs Discloses Significant Bitcoin ETF Investment

details: The cryptocurrency market experienced significant turbulence over the past 24 hours, with approximately $257 million in liquidations. Long positions bore the brunt of these liquidations, highlighting increased market volatility and risk for leveraged traders.
title: Crypto Market Sees $257M in Liquidations in 24 Hours, Long Positions Hit Hardest
